observations.summary: append_owner_zero_allow treats any NULL from acl_get_fd_np as 'no ACL' and starts empty; N0 shows no-ACL is NULL with ENOENT. Other errors would silently replace the ACL (RF-2 regression). Negligible for a test helper; fall back only on ENOENT and return other errno before any production promotion.
Test pins only the non-NULL fetch path and asserts rights only; add a fresh no-ACL case (Entries(1), rights 0) and assert kind 1 / User(uid) for both entries.
Test unsafe blocks (libc::getgid, libc::chown) lack // SAFETY: comments; std::os::unix::fs::chown removes one unsafe block.

The presence ACE remains a test fixture; a production marker must keep append semantics, the ENOENT-only fallback and an owner-neutral ACE, and its caller preconditions/inherited-ACE decision are creator policy for a separately reviewed unit.
